The '''1970–71 Serie A''' season was won by [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]].

==Teams==
[[Varese Calcio|Varese]], [[Foggia Calcio|Foggia]] and [[Catania Calcio|Catania]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
